items.verbatim: BOVINE RESPIRATORY DISEASE (BRD) IS THE LEADING CAUSE OF ILLNESS, DEATH, AND ECONOMIC LOSS BY INFECTIOUS DISEASE IN THE CATTLE INDUSTRY, RESPONSIBLE FOR OVER A BILLION DOLLARS IN ANNUAL COSTS IN THE UNITED STATES. BRD IS CAUSED BY A COMPLEX OF VIRAL AND BACTERIAL PATHOGENS INCLUDING BOVINE HERPESVIR

items.summary: NIHがTHYREOS INC(イリノイ州)に対しHSV-2(単純ヘルペスウイルス2型)の弱毒生ワクチン開発のSTTR研究助成として$1.66Mを交付。R2技術プラットフォームを用いたワクチン候補の作製と動物モデルでの安全性・免疫原性評価を行う。
items.verbatim: AN R2 NON-NEUROINVASIVE HERPES SIMPLEX VIRUS TYPE 2 VACCINE - PROJECT SUMMARY THERE IS AN UNMET NEED FOR A HERPES SIMPLEX VIRUS (HSV) VACCINE. WE PROPOSE TO DEVELOP A LIVE-ATTENUATED HSV-2 VACCINE BASED ON OUR R2 TECHNOLOGY PLATFORM. R2 VACCINES SHOW UNPRECEDENTED SAFETY AND EFFICACY IN ANIMAL MODEL
